label: API — Dashboard Endpoints
info:
Sessie 5: REST API endpoints voor het ERP Dashboard.

Levert drie endpoints:
- GET /api/sales-orders
- GET /api/work-orders
- GET /api/work-order-history

Elk endpoint voert een SQL query uit via `docker exec` op de TimescaleDB container en retourneert JSON met CORS headers.

name: === Dashboard API Endpoints (Sessie 5) ===
info:
Drie GET endpoints die data ophalen uit TimescaleDB via docker exec psql.
Het dashboard (dashboard.html) pollt deze endpoints elke 5 seconden.

name: psql: SELECT erp_sales_order
command: docker exec timescaledb psql -U postgres -d umh -t -A -c "SELECT json_agg(t) FROM (SELECT order_id, customer_name, status, milestone, due_date, order_date, delivered_date, change_type, created_at, updated_at FROM erp_sales_order ORDER BY order_date DESC) t"

name: Parse JSON + CORS
Error → 500
psql: SELECT erp_work_order
command: docker exec timescaledb psql -U postgres -d umh -t -A -c "SELECT json_agg(t) FROM (SELECT order_nr, product, qty, customer, priority, due_date, status, change_type, created_at, updated_at FROM erp_work_order ORDER BY priority ASC, due_date ASC) t"

name: Parse JSON + CORS
Error → 500
psql: SELECT erp_work_order_history
command: docker exec timescaledb psql -U postgres -d umh -t -A -c "SELECT json_agg(t) FROM (SELECT history_id, order_nr, product, qty, customer, priority, due_date, status, change_type, recorded_at FROM erp_work_order_history ORDER BY recorded_at DESC LIMIT 100) t"

name: Parse JSON + CORS
Error → 500

Deze handler retourneert de juiste CORS headers.
